messages:
matt: Heads-up: we're seeing p99 inference latency spikes and small packet loss on eastus2 ded-pool-3. Started ~10:02 UTC, correlates with a config rollout. Anyone digging in?

olivia: Yep alerts came in. p99 jumped from ~120ms -> ~280ms for short bursts, and a few 0.5-1% packet drops on intra-cluster flows between GPU nodes.

aj: Pulled a node (gpu-072) and ran some quick checks. `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` looks odd — fq_codel root is present but there's a classid redirect that shouldn't be there. Paste of output:

```
qdisc fq_codel 0: root refcnt 2 limit 10240pflows 1024 quantum 1514 ecn
  Sent 12345678 bytes 12345 pkts
qdisc clsact 0: ingress
  Sent 98765 bytes 987 pkts
class htb 1: parent 0: rate 10gbit ceil 10gbit prio 0 kind htb
class htb 1:300: prio 1 rate 9gbit ceil 10gbit
  policer: rate 800Mbit burst 10000b drop
  drop 120 packets
```

aj: The `classid 1:300` and policer look like an egress shaper for public traffic. But it's on the host NIC, which also carries east-west pod overlay. That explains redispatching and p99 blips.

samir: That matches — infra rollout `egress-shaper` landed ~10:00 and the Ansible pattern used `eth*` which matched host NICs that are used for pod traffic instead of only external-facing NICs. Oops.

matt: We intended to only shape traffic leaving to internet. Not intra-cluster overlay. Any quick mitigation?

aj: Quick mitigation I validated: `tc qdisc del dev eth0 root` on one node immediately dropped p99 back to normal. Then re-add a targeted fq_codel on the external-facing device only.

olivia: Confirmed on gpu-072: after `tc qdisc del` packet drops stopped and inference SLO reproved. We'll need a rolling fix; doing mass `tc del` is risky though.

infra-bot: rollout: egress-shaper v2 applied to 42 nodes in eastus2 at 2026-03-18T10:02:14Z (by ansible). Playbook: playbook-egress-shaper.yml

samir: Plan: revert the rollout on a small batch, update ansible to match `ens*` (node external NIC naming) and add inventory guard `when: group == "public-gateways"`. Also add an idempotent preflight that checks `ip link` for external routes.

aj: Will add a preflight check like:

```
- name: fail if fq_codel would apply to a non-external iface
  command: tc qdisc show dev {{item}}
  register: tcout
  failed_when: "'policer' in tcout.stdout and item in groups['internal_nodes']"
```

olivia: Also add a post-deploy smoke that runs a short p99 probe for inference endpoints (5m) and auto-rollback if p99 regresses > 30%.

matt: Rolling revert started on a 5-node batch. AJ will coordinate.

aj: Revert batch 1 complete (gpu-070..074). Observability shows p99 back to baseline on those. Pushing ansible change now as `egress-shaper@fix-iface-match`.

samir: After patch we'll run a canary (10 nodes) then full roll. Also updating runbook to warn about overlay NICs and MTU: check `ip link` MTUs; mixing 9000 vs 1500 can exacerbate issues.

matt: Good catch. Follow-ups: PR for ansible and runbook, postmortem draft if rollout > 1h impact.

olivia: I'll add the smoke test to Console (route-level) so we get automatic alerts next time.

matt: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
